text_block_list.text:
Following her commanding victory on the 
muddy track 
of the Oka Sho, the spotlight on Daring 
Tact 
grew exponentially brighter.

Even today, with the Oaks just around the 
corner, 
another interview request had come in—

text_block_list.name: Etsuko Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"—Thank you for your time. 
Can you hear me alright?"
choice_data_list: Yes, we can see you on screen as well.

text_block_list.name: Etsuko Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Wonderful! Well then, 
let's begin the interview. 
It's a pleasure to speak with you!"

As a precaution against the spread of 
infection, 
remote interviews had recently become 
standard practice, 
so today's session took place over a 
laptop screen once again.

text_block_list.name: Etsuko Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"First off, congratulations on your Oka 
Sho victory! 
It was a magnificent run... It's truly a 
shame 
we couldn't cheer for you in person at the 
venue."

text_block_list.name: Etsuko Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"I imagine this must be a difficult 
situation for horsegirls as well. 
What's the secret to keeping up your 
motivation?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Well, let's see.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"My motivation comes from... 
having people I want to deliver victory 
to."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hokkaido's Hidaka region... 
that rich, beautiful landscape is my 
hometown."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"The only reason I can challenge the 
Twinkle Series today... 
is because the people back home gave me a 
push 
and cheered me on."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"So this time, by securing victory... 
I want to give strength back to everyone."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I will bring the hope of the Triple Tiara 
home to Hidaka!"

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
"'—Perhaps Daring Tact's true strength 
lies within her devotion to her hometown. 
Interview by Etsuko Otonashi'...?"

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh... Daring Tact came all the way to 
Tokyo 
from Hidaka with nothing but what she 
could carry. 
And yet she pulled off a race like 
that...?"

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
"This horsegirl... she's just like me. 
I came from far away for school, too, 
so..."

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm stuck at home with nothing to do 
anyway. 
Maybe I'll check out the race."

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey, did you hear about Daring Tact? 
They say she's getting flooded with 
interview requests!"

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
"Right? Her fanbase blew up overnight, 
too, didn't it? 
It's amazing! She's shooting straight to 
stardom!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. 
It is as though her grand cinema has just 
begun."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: ...Which is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"I have something 
to say as well."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: It's so quiet again today...
choice_data_list: Hard to believe it's a GI race day.
Hard to believe it's a GI race day.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know what the future holds. 
So... I will simply choose to believe."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"This scene won't last forever. 
I know that someday soon, we'll all be 
celebrating together again..."

With hopes riding high on a Double Tiara 
victory, 
the Oaks was here. Unlike the heavy going 
of the Oka Sho, 
today's track was in firm condition. In 
other words—
choice_data_list: Today's race times are running fast.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, keeping up with the pace 
might take quite a toll on my stamina..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"And even with a late burst, 
there's a chance I might not reach the 
front."
choice_data_list: Keep a close eye on everyone around you.

text_block_list.text:
Her rivals appeared to have finally 
adjusted to this changed environment. 
Without the roar of the crowd, they were 
likely able to focus even better.
choice_data_list: They're going to mark you closely today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.
choice_data_list:
But—with your final spurt, you can break 
through anything!

But—with your final spurt, you can break 
through anything!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! 
I will believe in my own strength!"

Daring Tact headed toward the paddock. 
From here on, all I could do was watch. 
However, today—

It was sent over at our request 
by the folks from Daring Tact's hometown.

text_block_list.name: Racing Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
"'...She's here.' 'Daring Tact...' 
'She beat us last time, but next—' 
'Daring Tact—' 'Tact—'"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(Their gazes... are sharp, without a 
doubt. 
...However—)"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Tore-san?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Ah...! 
That banner...—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, I'm alright. 
I will—"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"—Say, Tact. 
We finally meet... upon this grand stage."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Win Marilyn...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"If there were spectators here right 
now... 
every single eye would undoubtedly 
be fixed upon you."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"I, too... I, too, was watching you. 
While everyone else was lost in dismay— 
you stood tall and proud."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Even caked in mud, 
you shone so brilliantly—"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"—And that is why 
I will not let you walk away alone!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: What—

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"As an actor, 
and as a horsegirl running in this race."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let you be the only light! 
To this current world, and into people's 
hearts... 
we shall deliver the finest cinema."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Your running roused us 
from our hesitation and spurred us to 
action."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Win Marilyn...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: ...Well now.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: Chatter's over!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Eep?!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Even if this movie's supposed to be 
yours... 
a story ain't nothin' without some drama!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"From here on out— 
it's the script where we take down the 
pure-white angel!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Bring it on, 
Daring Tact!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! 
Excuse me, I'm just so happy..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, I truly am. 
Knowing that you saw me, and accepted me 
for who I am."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, by all means— 
come at me with everything you've got!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Let's show everyone who's waiting 
for us—the greatest race possible!"
